newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Osem, Tnuva in ice-cream venture.
newsitem.headline: Osem, Tnuva in ice-cream venture.

text.p: Osem Investments Ltd and the Tnuva Co-Op have finalised an agreement to form a joint venture for the production of ice cream, Osem announced to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
The venture will be 51 percent owned by Osem and 49 percent owned by Tnuva, a statement to the bourse said.
The joint venture will acquire the equipment and operations of Snowcrest and Tane Noga, Tnuva's ice cream factories, for $30 million, to be paid to Tnuva.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval, the statement said.
Swiss giant Nestle owns nearly 40 percent of Osem, a producer of a variety of processed foods. Ice cream and dairy products is one area in which Osem was not active.

Tnuva, Israel's largest marketing and trading company, controls 75 percent of Israel's milk and dairy market. Snowcrest and Tane Noga had combined ice cream sales of $50 million last year, second in Israel after the privately held Nahariya Dairy Strauss Ltd.
